source_independence.derivatives: TradRadar and Webeconomia are separate secondary aggregators; both derive from exchange data but have different disclosed exchange/contract coverage. They are not fully independent market measurements.
source_independence.etf: CryptoKeyhole, XRP Insights and Alpha Finance are separate publishers using overlapping issuer files and differing fund universes; their flows are not independent confirmations.

model_admission.reason: Secondary aggregator data with source-vintage conflict, partial ETF publication, mixed universes and no synchronized primary exchange features.
